messages:
Maya: Quick sync — after yesterday's rollout we need to decide how to split the next 2 weeks: prioritize hotpath bug cleanup (latency, streaming regressions) or push forward the next-wave UX enhancements customers asked for.
Alex: Data point — error rate on the streaming endpoint spiked ~1.8% for medium requests after the model swap. It's concentrated in region us-west-2.
Luis: +1 to fix the streaming regressions first. Several customers filed support tickets and one is threatening to pause traffic.
Sam: What are the crash / P0 candidates vs the nice-to-haves? Can we list worst offenders and ETA to patch each?
Maya: Good call. I'll paste a short list from Sentry/telemetry:
- streaming-retry-loop: ~0.9% errors, likely kv-cache mismatch
- tokenization-edge-case: 0.4% errors for long inputs
- routing-fallback: 0.5% higher p95 in EU region
(others <0.2%)
Chris: For the UX items customers want: conversational history pin, per-route token cost breakdown in console, and a small tweak to the retry UX. All useful but none are immediate outages.
Priya: From CS: the three customers who reported the streaming issue are on Dedicated, high ARR. They'd consider a formal escalation unless we show a plan within 24 hours.
Alex: Rough estimates: streaming fix ~2 engineer-days (patch + canary + infra tweak), tokenization fix ~3 days (model eval + tests), routing p95 tune ~1 day. That's parallelizable but needs infra/ops time for canaries.
Maya: Suggestion: priority banding — P0 (hotpath regression fixes) -> P1 (small perf & ops improvements) -> P2 (console UX + enhancements). Propose 60/40 dev allocation (fixes:enhancements) for the next 10 working days.
Luis: 60/40 seems reasonable. If we do that, what are rollback thresholds for the model swap? DevBot: deployment-checklist: canary >= 0.5% traffic w/ error <0.3% over 30m = green.
Sam: Can we do a 48-hour stabilization window with daily check-ins, and keep the console enhancements in a separate branch for a follow-on week? That reduces churn.
Maya: OK action items: Alex + Luis own streaming-retry patch (target PR today, canary tomorrow). Sam to own tokenization edge-case. Chris to scope console work into a thin MVP we can pause if needed.
Priya: I'll draft a customer update template for CS that outlines timeline and mitigation; want to avoid escalation.
Alex: One ask — we should also enable extended logs for affected canaries (safeguarded by a sampling flag) so we can reproduce quicker.
Maya: Agree. Sam, can you add sampling flag to rollout plan? If yes, we block the flag behind feature gate and monitor.
Sam: Yep — adding to PR. ETA end of day.
Luis: If canary metrics don't improve in 6 hours, plan B is to roll back model to previous variant and spin up dedicated incidents channel. Anyone object?
Chris: No objections. We should notify partners and update the runbook with model rollback steps.
Maya: Great. We'll proceed with the 60/40 split for next two weeks unless telemetry says otherwise. I'll create a short follow-up doc with the timeline and owners. Check-in at 09:30 tomorrow.
Priya: Added to calendar + sending CS note draft for review.
DevBot: Reminder: incident channel #release-war-room created for this thread. :loud_sound:
